newsitem.title: USA: Parlux expects to return to profitability.
newsitem.headline: Parlux expects to return to profitability.

text.p: Parlux Fragrances Inc said Thursday the restructuring costs associated with terminating warehousing and distribution operations in Connecticut and France and discontinuing certain brands would approximate $5,000,000 on a pre-tax basis during the quarter ending March 31, 1997.
The company said it expects to retain a profit for the full fiscal year ending March 31, 1997. About 85 percent of these charges will not require cash outlay.
The discontinued brands represented less than five percent of the company's total sales for the year, Parlux said.
Parlux also said sales to its major customer, Perfumania Inc, as a percentage of total sales, have been strategically reduced during the current fiscal year compared to the prior year.
The company said it intends to continue with this strategy in the upcoming year to improve receivable turnover.
